# Akshardeep Engineers — Comprehensive Information & Documentation

> Authorised Channel Partner for Forbes Marshall, Intervalve, and El-O-Matic. Providing cost-effective, efficient, and robust solutions for industrial flow control, pneumatic valve automation, process instrumentation, and diaphragm seal replacement services in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, India.

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Established in 2013, Akshardeep Engineers is a premier engineering solutions provider based in Ankleshwar GIDC, Gujarat — India's chemical and industrial hub. With over 14 years of industry expertise, a 5,420+ Sq. Ft. state-of-the-art facility, and partnerships with global industrial pioneers, Akshardeep Engineers serves over 200+ clients across chemical, pharmaceutical, oil & gas, power, steel, fertilizer, and manufacturing industries.

## 3. Authorised Channel Partnerships & Brands

### Forbes Marshall (HVY) Pvt. Ltd.
Authorised partner for steam traps (thermodynamic, ball float, bimetallic), control valves (1/2" to 16"), flowmeters, and steam/process energy conservation products.

### Intervalve Poonamwala Pvt. Ltd.
Authorised partner for industrial butterfly valves (concentric bonded/replaceable seat, PTFE seated, triple offset HP), gate valves, globe valves, check valves, and ball valves.

### El-O-Matic India Pvt. Ltd.
Authorised partner for rack-and-pinion pneumatic actuators (P-Series & E-Series, 4 to 4022 Nm torque), SIL 3 certified ON/OFF valve automation assemblies, positioners, and limit switch boxes.

### Badotherm India (JV Badotherm Holland Inc., Est. 1957)
High-quality diaphragm seal manufacturing and transmitter seal replacement service for all major transmitter brands (Emerson Rosemount, Yokogawa, Endress+Hauser, ABB, Siemens, Honeywell).

### Additional Supported Brands
Badotherm, Yokogawa, ABB, Emerson, Rotork, Endress+Hauser, Siemens, Honeywell.

## 4. Product Portfolio & Technical Specifications

### 4.1 Butterfly Valves
- **Models**: IVGKL, IVGKB, IVTLB, IVDF, IVGKR, IVTL, IVEX-T, IVEX-M, IVTEX
- **Size Range**: 40 NB to 1200 NB (Concentric) | 50 NB to 750 NB (High Performance)
- **Pressure Rating**: PN10, PN16 | ASME Class #150, #300, #600
- **Seat Options**: Nitrile, EPDM, Neoprene, Hypalon, Viton, Silicon, PTFE, GFT, Inconel-625
- **Design Standards**: API 609, ISO 5752, BS EN558
- **Operating Temp**: -50°C to +540°C

### 4.2 Ball Valves
- **Configurations**: 2/3 Piece Trunnion Mounted, 2 Piece Floating, 3 Piece Forged Steel, Jacketed Floating, 3-Way Ball Valves, Tank Bottom Ball Valves
- **Size Range**: 15 NB to 700 NB
- **Pressure Rating**: ASME Class #150 to Class #2500 | Class #800 (Forged)
- **Seat Options**: PTFE, GFT, CFT, Devlon, PEEK, Metal Seated (CRC / TCC / Stellite)
- **Testing Standards**: API 6D, BS EN ISO 5208, API 598, BS EN ISO 17292
- **Features**: Fire Safe (API 607), Full Bore, Anti-Static, SIL Rated

### 4.3 Gate, Globe & Check Valves
- **Types**: Cast Steel Gate/Globe/Check, Forged Steel Gate/Globe, Dual Plate Check, Wafer Type Single Plate Check (IVC / IVCT)
- **Size Range**: 15 NB to 1500 NB
- **Pressure Rating**: ASME Class #150, #300, #600 (Cast) | Class #150 to #2500 (Forged)
- **Design Standards**: API 600, BS 1873, BS 1868, API 602, API 594
- **Testing Standard**: API 598

### 4.4 Specialty Valves & Accessories
- **Lined Valves**: PFA / FEP Lined Ball, Butterfly & Plug Valves (15 mm to 300 mm)
- **Jacketed Valves**: Jacketed Floating Ball Valves (15 mm to 250 mm NB, ASME #150 & #300)
- **3-Way Valves**: T-Port & L-Port Floating Ball Valves
- **Strainers**: Y-Type Strainers (25 NB to 150 NB) and Basket Strainers (SS304/SS316/Duplex mesh)
- **Sight Glasses**: Full View Sight Glasses & Double Window Sight Glasses (15 NB to 150 NB, up to 10 kg/cm²)

### 4.5 Valve Automation
- **Actuators**: El-O-Matic Single Acting (SA) & Double Acting (DA) Rack & Pinion
- **P-Series Torque**: 4 to 4022 Nm @ 3–7 Bar air supply (6–14 springs)
- **E-Series Torque**: 4 to 1423 Nm @ 3–6 Bar air supply (3–6 springs)
- **Certifications**: SIL 3 Certified, Fire Safe, 5 Lakh Cycles Minimum Life
- **Accessories**: Smart Positioners (HART/Modbus), Solenoid Valves (3/2, 5/2 way), Limit Switches, Air Filter Regulators (AFR), SCADA/DCS Control Panels

### 4.6 Diaphragm Seal Replacement (Badotherm Partnership)
- **Concept**: Replace the failed diaphragm seal — not the entire expensive transmitter.
- **Diaphragm Materials**: SS316L, Hastelloy-C276, Duplex 2205, Monel 400, Inconel 825, Tantalum, Gold Coating (25/40 µm), PTFE/PFA Coating
- **Process Connections**: Flanged (1" to 4" CL 150# to 2500#), Threaded (1/4" to 2" NPT), Triclover Sanitary
- **Fill Fluids**: BSO-18 (-10 to +315°C), BSO-22 (-50 to +225°C), BSO-48 (-20 to +420°C), BSO-01 (-110 to +100°C)

### 4.7 Process Instrumentation
- **Pressure Gauges**: Nominal sizes 63, 100, 150, 200, 250 mm; Ranges -760 mmHg to 700 kg/cm²; Class ±1.0% FS; IP67
- **Chemical Seal Gauges**: Threaded, Flanged & Triclover connections with NABL traceability
- **Temperature Sensors**: RTD PT-100 sensors (-200°C to 450°C, Class A/B), Thermocouples (J, K, N, R, S, B, T, E)
- **Temperature Gauges**: Bimetallic & Gas-Filled gauges (-50°C to 600°C, EN13190 compliant)
- **Level Monitoring**: Side & Top Mounted Level Switches (SS316 floats, IP67/flameproof enclosures)

### 4.8 Pneumatics & Process Instruments
- **Flowmeters**: Electromagnetic, Coriolis Mass, Ultrasonic, Vortex, Variable Area (Yokogawa, Emerson, ABB, Endress+Hauser makes)
- **Control Valves**: Globe type control valves 1/2" to 16" WCB/CF8M with HART positioners
- **Safety Relief Valves**: 25 NB × 50 NB to 250 NB × 350 NB; 0.7 to 90 kg/cm²; -40°C to +538°C (IBR / EIL approved)
- **Steam Traps**: Thermodynamic, Ball Float, Bimetallic Thermostatic steam traps by Forbes Marshall

---

## 5. Engineering & Workshop Services

1. **Valve Repair & Overhaul**: Servicing and refurbishing all sizes, types, makes, and pressure ratings.
2. **NABL Traceable Calibration**: Calibration of positioners, pressure transmitters, and temperature gauges.
3. **Hydrostatic & Seat Leak Testing**: Complete testing per API 598 and ISO 5208 standards.
4. **Actuator & Positioner Mounting**: Precision alignment, bracket fabrication, and functional testing.
5. **Diaphragm Seal Repair**: Custom seal replacement for all major transmitter brands.
6. **Emergency Field Support**: Rapid on-site technician response for shutdowns, commissioning, and urgent repairs.
